description: Broadcasts a signed raw Ethereum transaction to the network. signedTransaction must be 0x-prefixed RLP-encoded hex obtained from local wallet signing (e.g. ethers `wallet.signTransaction(tx)`). Returns: transaction hash, block number, and gas used.

configId.description: Boson/Fermion Protocol deployment identifier. Format: '<env>-<chainId>-<index>' e.g. 'production-137-0' (Polygon mainnet), 'testing-80002-0' (Amoy testnet). Call get_config_ids to list all valid values for this server.

signedTransaction.description: RLP-encoded signed Ethereum transaction as 0x-prefixed hex string. Obtain from local wallet signing (e.g. ethers `wallet.signTransaction(tx)`).

name: send_signed_transaction
